title: dashboard: CoAP context never closed - resource leak on shutdown
description:
P1 bug in python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py

**Location:** lines 71-78 (creation), 400-408 (lifespan)

**Issue:** _coap_ctx is created via Context.create_client_context() but never closed. The _lifespan() context manager starts/stops the refresh task but does NOT call _coap_ctx.shutdown().

**Impact:** aiocoap contexts hold UDP sockets and internal state. Without shutdown(), sockets leak on server restart. Repeated restarts could exhaust file descriptors.

**Fix:** Add _coap_ctx cleanup to _lifespan():
```python
@asynccontextmanager
async def _lifespan(app: Starlette) -> AsyncGenerator[None, None]:
    await _start_refresh_task()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        await _stop_refresh_task()
        if _coap_ctx is not None:
            await _coap_ctx.shutdown()
```
